rows.en: Defeat enemy forces
rows.speaker: System

rows.en: City damage reaches 40%
rows.speaker: System

rows.en: Our demand: release our captured brethren.
rows.speaker: Grados terrorist leader

rows.en: Refuse, and we blow up this city with us.
rows.speaker: Grados terrorist leader

rows.en: We are serious. We expect a wise decision.
rows.speaker: Grados terrorist leader

rows.en: Analysis in! Their units are loaded with explosives!
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum operator?

rows.en: Destroy them carelessly and the city gets caught too!
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum operator?

rows.en: Take them out while keeping the damage to a minimum!
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Enemy reinforcements incoming!
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum operator?

rows.en: Message from Commander Misumaru, United Space Force.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum operator?

rows.en: Thank you for answering our request.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru

rows.en: Lately the UCE looks down on Spacenoids, and
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru

rows.en: it rarely lends a hand in cases like this one.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru

rows.en: Out in space, distrust of the UCE runs deep,
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru

rows.en: and anti-UCE activity is on the rise as well.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru

rows.en: I want you all to know how things stand.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru

rows.en: Well then, I'll take my leave.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru

rows.en: Incoming message from the mayor.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum operator?

rows.en: The mayor says no further damage can be tolerated.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum operator?

rows.en: All enemy signals in the area are gone.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum operator?

rows.en: Looks like we managed to keep the damage down.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: I can't believe we're this outmatched...
rows.speaker: Grados terrorist leader

rows.en: We're receiving a surrender transmission from Grados.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum operator?

rows.en: Looks like we managed to keep the damage down.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: And there's a message of thanks from the mayor.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Emergency transmission from the mayor!
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum operator?

rows.en: Residents' lives can't be sustained like this, so
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum operator?

rows.en: the mayor has given in to the terrorists' demands.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum operator?

rows.en: Is there nothing more we can do...!?
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Lure them somewhere wide open and fight them there!
rows.speaker: operator (slot 1)

rows.en: Draw them into open space and fight them there.
rows.speaker: operator (slot 2)

rows.en: Please fight in an open area to keep damage down.
rows.speaker: operator (slot 3)

rows.en: Pull them out somewhere open before you fight them!
rows.speaker: operator (slot 4)

rows.en: Lure 'em out somewhere roomy and fight there!
rows.speaker: operator (slot 5)

rows.en: Fight somewhere open where there's less damage, okay?
rows.speaker: operator (slot 6)

rows.en: DESTROY TARGETS WHERE PROJECTED DAMAGE IS LOW.
rows.speaker: operator (slot 7)

rows.en: Please fight somewhere open where there's no damage!
rows.speaker: operator (slot 8)

rows.en: Take the fight somewhere open.
rows.speaker: operator (slot 9)

rows.en: Please defeat them in an open area, out of harm's way.
rows.speaker: operator (slot 10)

rows.en: You can't wreck the city!
rows.speaker: operator (slot 1)

rows.en: Make sure you don't cause any damage to the city.
rows.speaker: operator (slot 2)

rows.en: Please keep the damage to the city down.
rows.speaker: operator (slot 3)

rows.en: Be careful not to wreck the city.
rows.speaker: operator (slot 4)

rows.en: Wrecking the city is a no-no, got it!?
rows.speaker: operator (slot 5)

rows.en: Be careful not to destroy the city, okay?
rows.speaker: operator (slot 6)

rows.en: MINIMIZE DAMAGE TO URBAN AREA.
rows.speaker: operator (slot 7)

rows.en: Please don't destroy the city!
rows.speaker: operator (slot 8)

rows.en: Don't destroy the city. I'm counting on you.
rows.speaker: operator (slot 9)

rows.en: Please take care not to destroy the city.
rows.speaker: operator (slot 10)
